color_story: A harvest-gold split-field: cream evidence panels against a deep espresso thesis panel, with one marigold pulse on the weekend's two Detroit wins, warm and structural like a builder's ledger. Primary sits at 44°, inside the 40–80° target; the recent-palette avoid band overlaps that target (0–80° forbidden while 40–80° is named the goal), so I honored the explicit target range and moved to 44° to sit clear of the 50° gold used four builds back, differentiating on formula (split-field, not that day's duotone) and on object rather than only on hue.
